name: Bad Things That Happen To Good People
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality that even the righteous experience suffering and unanswered questions, as seen in the psalmist's cries asking why God seems distant in times of trouble. Yet, the Bible encourages believers to commit their ways to the Lord and trust in His sovereign plan, recognizing that God’s purposes are ultimately for peace and a hopeful future. The righteous may perish, but this is understood as being taken away from coming evil, while God's providence extends to both the just and the unjust, demonstrating His impartial care.
